title: eval-harness: add per-prompt regression CI hooks and quality gating
author: Aisha Khan
description:
Motivation: We want to catch prompt-set regressions and quality drops earlier by running a lightweight per-prompt eval during PRs and gating merges on configurable thresholds. This change wires the eval-harness into the repo CI as a standalone GH action and a GitHub Checks job, adds per-prompt thresholds, and exposes a fail/soft-fail policy to make adoption gradual.

What this PR does:
- Adds .github/workflows/eval-per-prompt.yaml to run a curated subset of prompts on changed models/prompt-sets. The job is fast (sharded, cached) and reports a per-prompt metric summary back to GitHub Checks.
- Adds tooling at eval-harness/scripts/ci_reporter.py to format results and annotate PRs with failing prompts.
- Introduces config/eval/per_prompt_thresholds.json (defaults) and per-repo override semantics.
- Implements a new gating strategy: hard-fail for critical prompt-sets; soft-fail (warning) for low-confidence regressions. Policy is configurable via repo labels and Linear triggers.
- Adds unit tests and CI mocks for reporter + GH checks integration.

Testing: Local unit tests (pytest) and integration tests using the CI harness were added. I ran end-to-end checks on a staging branch and validated annotations appear on PR pages, and that the gating logic respects the soft-fail label and Linear workflow.

Rollout plan: Start with soft-fail only on main for two weeks, flip hard-fail for critical prompt-sets after monitoring false positive rate < 2% and after internal sign-off.

Checklist:
- [x] Add GH workflow and reporter
- [x] Add default thresholds and docs
- [x] Tests + CI integration
- [x] Notify infra and SRE for production rollout

Related: ENG-4523 (per-prompt CI), PM-1107 (quality gates), SUP-3245 (support case that triggered alerting needs).
